verification: Editorial review of author-supplied notes, current asset export and historical audit conclusions; no new UE/RenderDoc experiment performed for this update.

current_v2.scope: Project-authored clump derived from extracted source resources, not the unmodified original vegetation block.
current_v2.alignment: One clump orientation per rock hit normal; texture adds pixel normal variation.
current_v2.shading: Default Lit, two-sided Masked; SSS disabled

root_support.limit: Root samples only; no guarantee against tip intersections or overhang.

current_v2.instancing: HISM grouped by receiver rock component and mesh; screen-size LOD; A/B UV selection via instance custom data.

original_lighting.evidence: Moss GBuffer consumers traced to sun and environment passes; original sun Schlick-like Fresnel confirmed.
original_lighting.transmission_scope: Zero weight for verified moss samples in this sun path, not a whole-game SSS claim.

historical_tests.alpha: Four variants; dynamic scene time continued, so full-image differences are not isolated errors.
historical_tests.ao_calibration: Specific UE4 branch/path: radius subtracts 70, full-resolution intensity adds .15, bias multiplies by 5. Historical settings, not universal conversion or current production defaults.
historical_tests.contact_shadow: GPU constants, not only Python property reads, were checked. Experimental self-skip shader was reverted.
historical_tests.sampler: Engine-module rebuild; fixed-camera BaseColor 1x -> 8x -> 1x with AA off and zero mip bias. First/last ROI difference zero. This ROI was rock, not a whole-scene moss quality metric.
